Due to a technical issue, Heliod, Sun-Crowned was omitted from the product Secret Lair: Valentine’s Day 2021.
This replacement pack from Wizards of the Coast contains:
• 1 (one) Heliod, Sun-Crowned
• 5 (five) Goblin tokens (from Secret Lair: Valentine’s Day 2021)
